answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind cryptographic stake to a quadratic burn function where verification costs scale superlinearly as O(N^2). When an attacker floods nodes, each duplicate action triggers an exponential stake burn penalty. Collusion cannot cross this economic ledge without catastrophic capital loss. Redundant identities only echo empty claims into a sunken liquidity lagoon, guaranteeing total financial ruin for adversaries.
